name: Chaleemongkolasana and Maleeratanabanlang Residences
scope: The standing Chaleemongkolasana and Maleeratanabanlang exteriors at Sanam Chandra Palace and their physically attached upper-floor covered crossing. Includes the north château façade and spired corner towers, red-tile roofs, timber Thai-Western residence and roofed bridge. The separately placed dog monument, shrine and northern halls have independent scopes.

originalReview.notes: Exact public-domain photograph from the north lawn. Pale yellow walls, red steep main roof and tower cones, two tall central gate towers, pierced façade parapet and stone balustrades, dark half-timbered bay under a pediment and front pointed arch.

review.method: Exact same-account PD-self original and independent site documentation
review.notes: Reviewed Qualla first. Its four public-domain labels cover Vajariromaya, Bhimarn Prathom, Thap Khwan and the separate dog monument. The hero filename still names Samakkhi Mukhamat but the creator’s current native description and the visible structure identify Vajariromaya. The Qualla images of the linked residences require attribution. Used only Ananda’s native photographer-dedicated château original for the connected pair, with written controls for the rear, bridge and the companion residence.
